alpengrendel.name: Alpengrendel
alpengrendel.subtitle: Brute of the Frozen Peaks
alpengrendel.body: Hulking creatures shaggy with bluish-white fur, crowned with great tusks and horns. They keep to the high, cold places of the world, and travellers who meet one speak of the bitter chill that hangs about it like a second hide.

bat_hound.name: Bat Hound
bat_hound.subtitle: Bloodthirsty Hunter of the Night
bat_hound.body: Lean, leathery hounds with bat-like ears and a hunter's patience, kept by those who hunt after dark. Once they have the scent of blood they run down horse and rider alike, and they are said to bring stragglers back alive for their masters.

bayou_beast.name: Bayou Beast
bayou_beast.subtitle: Walking Mound of the Swamp
bayou_beast.body: Great heaving mounds of reed, moss and black mud that rise out of the bayou on their own. Swamp-folk give them a very wide berth.

boneflayer.name: Boneflayer
boneflayer.subtitle: Voracious Carrion Eater
boneflayer.body: Cruel, vulture-like creatures with filth-crusted beaks that do not wait for a meal to die. They snatch prey into the sky and let it fall. Villages that fear them beat drums and gongs whenever one circles overhead.

boogleswarm.name: Boogleswarm
boogleswarm.subtitle: Mob of Tooth-Thieving Weasels
boogleswarm.body: A slinking, chittering mob of weasels with too-knowing eyes. They covet teeth of every kind, and the old tales of tooth faeries trading coins for children's milk teeth may have started with them.

centipede_hag.name: Centipede Hag
centipede_hag.subtitle: Hag of the Deep Places
centipede_hag.body: A crone of the dark tunnels, swarming with centipedes, whose lair reeks of sickness and whose interest in the human body is far too keen. One of three sisters, if the stories are true.

corvodaemon.name: Corvodaemon
corvodaemon.subtitle: Six-Eyed Crow
corvodaemon.body: A monstrous crow with sleek, twisted wings tipped in finger-like claws, and six amber eyes always searching. Its cawing sounds unsettlingly like speech.

crimson_clergy.name: Crimson Clergy
crimson_clergy.subtitle: Bloodless Zealot
crimson_clergy.body: The most devoted of the Crimson Faith: pale, vacant-eyed and soft-spoken, with the occasional glint of a fang. They speak of blood as something sacred, and of the Crimson Rose with an adoration that never wavers.

crooked_effigy.name: Crooked Effigy
crooked_effigy.subtitle: Thorned Wooden Figure
crooked_effigy.body: Gnarled figures of twisted wood and thorn, roughly the shape of a woman, with branch-like arms. Where they appear, the old stories of the hollow's first queen are never far behind.

crooked_man.name: Crooked Man
crooked_man.subtitle: The Man With the Crooked Grin
crooked_man.body: A tall, gnarled figure of snapped and twisted limbs and a grin that stretches too wide, with curling claws for fingers. He is named in every frightening tale the hollow tells its children, and he seems to enjoy it.

crowstorm.name: Crowstorm
crowstorm.subtitle: Fiendish Murder
crowstorm.body: A great swirling mass of black feathers and harsh, endless cawing — hundreds of crows flying as one, their beady eyes weeping blood. Within the din, some swear they hear whispered pleading.

deepdreck.name: Deepdreck
deepdreck.subtitle: Lost Thing of the Mine
deepdreck.body: Misshapen, cringing figures that haunt the deep tunnels, wearing scraps of what might once have been miners' clothes. They keep to the dark and scurry away from light and company alike.

drakkenhob.name: Drakkenhob
drakkenhob.subtitle: Prancer of Parades
drakkenhob.body: At a glance, a costumed festival horse — a rider in a painted hobby-horse, the kind that prances at every fair and parade, to the delight of the crowds.

dream_eater.name: Dream Eater
dream_eater.subtitle: Devourer of Nightmares
dream_eater.body: Great owl-like creatures with drab outer feathers that open onto a dazzling cascade of shifting colour beneath. Their beaks are full of blunt, human-looking teeth.

ferryman.name: Ferryman
ferryman.subtitle: Lantern-Bearing Boatman
ferryman.body: Gaunt dead men who pole coffin-shaped boats through the bayous and rivers by lantern light. They will carry passengers who pay — and in the Drowned Crossroads they are said to serve behind the bar, too.

festerhulk.name: Festerhulk
festerhulk.subtitle: Fungal Undead Giant
festerhulk.body: The corpses of giants, overgrown with mushrooms and fungal blooms until little flesh remains, lurching on regardless. A cloud of spores drifts wherever they walk.

fleshdobbin.name: Fleshdobbin
fleshdobbin.subtitle: Horse and Rider Made One
fleshdobbin.body: From a distance, a saddled horse without a rider. Closer, the truth: horse and rider fused into one twisted creature, each leg ending in a gnarled, clawed human hand, its cry a mingled shriek of man and beast.

gloomwood.name: Gloomwood
gloomwood.subtitle: Blighted Treant
gloomwood.body: Towering walking trees whose bark is bored through with sickly fungus. Spores drift from their branches, and the ground where they have stood soon begins to rot.

gobblegeist.name: Gobblegeist
gobblegeist.subtitle: Blood-Drinking Avian Predator
gobblegeist.body: Massive birds with earth-toned plumage, reptilian faces and claws, and a metallic beak edged with teeth. A single unblinking eye watches from the treetops before it drops to snatch prey and carry it away.

herald_of_fools.name: Herald of Fools
herald_of_fools.subtitle: Leader of Fiendish Revels
herald_of_fools.body: Graceful, dancing figures who lead troupes of revellers, spinning their banner poles in dazzling displays. Their celebrations are wonderful to watch, and they do not take kindly to anyone who refuses to join.

hospital_horror.name: Hospital Horror
hospital_horror.subtitle: Mutated Experiment
hospital_horror.body: Hulking, scarred figures that were once people, stitched and altered almost past recognition. They seem to remember nothing of who they were, and answer only to the voices of those who keep them.

house_of_horror.name: House of Horror
house_of_horror.subtitle: The House That Hungers
house_of_horror.body: An abandoned house the children dare each other to enter — and the ones who do never come back. Its rooms do not stay where they were, its doors lead somewhere new each time, and it does not want its guests to leave.

hypnovulfen.name: Hypnovulfen
hypnovulfen.subtitle: Hungry Wolf of the Shadows
hypnovulfen.body: Massive wolves with unnaturally large orange eyes and wide, crooked maws, far quieter than anything that size has any right to be.

invader_out_of_space.name: Invader Out of Space
invader_out_of_space.subtitle: Visitor From Beyond the Stars
invader_out_of_space.body: Something that fell from the sky inside a burning stone. Few who have seen one can describe it the same way twice.

kackle.name: Kackle
kackle.subtitle: Laughing Lantern Bearer
kackle.body: A ghostly figure in a tattered cloak and hood, always drifting just out of sight, carrying a lantern of pale fire. Its hollow laughter echoes through dark places, fading in and out until you cannot tell where it is coming from.

keeper_of_the_blight.name: Keeper of the Blight
keeper_of_the_blight.subtitle: Drummer of the Rot
keeper_of_the_blight.body: Tall, antlered figures draped in moss and fungus who lead the drum circles of the blighted wood, chanting in an old tongue. The air around them is thick and sweet with decay.

ketgrinn.name: Ketgrinn
ketgrinn.subtitle: Grinning Feline Trickster
ketgrinn.body: Catlike spirits with large, bright eyes and a too-wide grin that gleams even in shadow. They love riddles, puzzles and bargains — and they always seem to want something.

lake_dredger.name: Lake Dredger
lake_dredger.subtitle: Horror of the Deep Water
lake_dredger.body: A bloated, long-necked thing rotting beneath the kelp, the kind of shape old sailors only describe after a few drinks. It drifts along the bottom of deep lakes and rivers.

lurker_in_the_dark.name: Lurker in the Dark
lurker_in_the_dark.subtitle: Thing That Goes Bump in the Night
lurker_in_the_dark.body: Grey-skinned, lank-haired figures with three-fingered claws and limbs that bend in all the wrong places. They whisper from places no one could fit — under beds, behind wardrobes — and the frightened and the lonely are said to vanish with them.

maidenwood.name: Maidenwood
maidenwood.subtitle: Witch-Warped Tree
maidenwood.body: A gnarled stump that scuttles on its roots like legs, its broken trunk a grinding maw. Its tendrils blossom into lifelike figures — often a beckoning young woman — to draw travellers close.

mutant_nurse.name: Mutant Nurse
mutant_nurse.subtitle: Porcelain-Masked Caregiver
mutant_nurse.body: Nurses in starched uniforms whose faces are hidden behind white porcelain masks shaped like the faces they once had. Something moves beneath their skin that should not. They tend their patients with unwavering devotion, whether the patients wish it or not.

necrolisk.name: Necrolisk
necrolisk.subtitle: Burrower in the Dark
necrolisk.body: Something huge that tunnels through the deep places of the earth, leaving its burrows lined with foul, shimmering slime.

night_creature.name: Night Creature
night_creature.subtitle: Bestial Blood Hunter
night_creature.body: Hulking, bestial brutes with a vampire's hunger and none of a vampire's grace, kept by those who rule the night. They hunt with the single-minded loyalty of a hound.

old_ways_chosen.name: Old Ways Chosen
old_ways_chosen.subtitle: Devout Follower of Old Gods
old_ways_chosen.body: Keepers of the last embers of the Old Ways, the forgotten gods of remote and wild places, recognisable by their antlers, masks and offerings. Some keep to themselves; others welcome outsiders with open arms, for reasons of their own.

phantom_hearse.name: Phantom Hearse
phantom_hearse.subtitle: Ghostly Coach of the Dead
phantom_hearse.body: A spectral black carriage drawn by ghostly horses, its coachmen wailing, a bell tolling ahead of it. Those who hear that bell are told never to look back.

pigeon_hag.name: Pigeon Hag
pigeon_hag.subtitle: Hag of Feathers and Whispers
pigeon_hag.body: A crone always surrounded by pigeons, who seems to know every rumour and secret in the hollow before anyone else does. One of three sisters, if the stories are true.

pumpkin_head.name: Pumpkin Head
pumpkin_head.subtitle: Scarecrow That Walks
pumpkin_head.body: Scarecrows of straw, sticks and old clothes topped with a carved pumpkin, which wander away from their posts at night. The worst of it is that, sometimes, they speak.

reveler_of_song.name: Reveler of Song
reveler_of_song.subtitle: Fiend of Music and Dance
reveler_of_song.body: Wild musicians who never stop playing — droning hurdy-gurdies wreathed in bees, drums that shake the ground, bells that drown out every other sound. Their invitations to dance are hard to refuse, and refusing them is said to be a terrible mistake.

reveler_of_stories.name: Reveler of Stories
reveler_of_stories.subtitle: Fiend of Legend and Folklore
reveler_of_stories.body: Figures stepped out of old tales — a great beast, a storybook hero, a wicked witch — each a dark mirror of the story it came from. They play their parts with relish, and the endings are never happy.

rotweaver.name: Rotweaver
rotweaver.subtitle: Thrall of the Rot
rotweaver.body: Small fey creatures of moss and mould who tend the blight the way others tend a garden, and hunt those who would stop it.

serum_brute.name: Serum Brute
serum_brute.subtitle: Stitched and Tubed Giant
serum_brute.body: Huge, sorrowful giants with their eyes sewn shut and glass vessels and tubes threaded into their bodies. They move as if in constant pain.

shrouded.name: Shrouded
shrouded.subtitle: Whispering Dead
shrouded.body: Grey, half-formed spirits of the dead that drift out of the mists, endlessly whispering every failing and weakness of the living they come near.

skitterswarm.name: Skitterswarm
skitterswarm.subtitle: Fetid Fey Centipedes
skitterswarm.body: A squirming carpet of centipedes that pours out of the foulest places — drains, middens, abandoned mines. Where they gather, sickness follows.

soulfire_stoker.name: Soulfire Stoker
soulfire_stoker.subtitle: Spirit of the Firebox
soulfire_stoker.body: A roaring shape of ghostly green flame, steam and phantom iron plating that lives in a furnace and tends its fire. It does not care much what — or who — it feeds into the flames.

squabswarm.name: Squabswarm
squabswarm.subtitle: Peeping Fey Pigeons
squabswarm.body: A flock of pigeons that seems to watch a little too closely, and that turns up wherever you go. Folk say some pigeons carry more than letters.

vermin_familiar.name: Vermin Familiar
vermin_familiar.subtitle: Pest With Too-Clever Eyes
vermin_familiar.body: A weasel, a centipede or a pigeon at first glance — until it watches you with far more cunning than any pest should have. They are found in the company of those who practise darker crafts.

vermin_infestation.name: Vermin Infestation
vermin_infestation.subtitle: Swarm of Verminous Familiars
vermin_infestation.body: A nightmarish tangle of centipedes, pigeons and weasels moving as one frenzied, shrieking mass. Thankfully rare.

wayward_haint.name: Wayward Haint
wayward_haint.subtitle: Lost Soul Bound to Regret
wayward_haint.body: Restless spirits caught between the living and the dead, repeating the same small acts over and over — eating, weeping, hauling, performing. They take shapes that hint at whatever loss holds them back, and can sometimes be helped to move on.

weasel_hag.name: Weasel Hag
weasel_hag.subtitle: Hag of Teeth and Nightmares
weasel_hag.body: A covetous crone strung with necklaces of stolen and gifted teeth, attended by weasels and boogleswarms. She deals in temptation and bad dreams. The youngest of three sisters, if the stories are true.

wellwyrm.name: Wellwyrm
wellwyrm.subtitle: Serpent Lurking Beneath the Surface
wellwyrm.body: Long, pale serpents that lie in wells, ponds and watering holes, waiting for something to come close enough to the water's edge.

wildpyre.name: Wildpyre
wildpyre.subtitle: Spectral Blazing Beast
wildpyre.body: The ghost of an animal made of living flame — a stag, a hound, a great cat — lashing out at anything near it as if it were still burning.

woodwarped.name: Woodwarped
woodwarped.subtitle: Root-Grown Likeness
woodwarped.body: Figures of tangled root and bark grown into the crude likeness of a person, sometimes wearing that person's clothes. Forest-folk whisper of a cursed vine behind them.

wormhost_surgeon.name: Wormhost Surgeon
wormhost_surgeon.subtitle: Unsettling Surgeon
wormhost_surgeon.body: Doctors who pass for ordinary people at a glance, always wearing a cap or hood. Their interest in anatomy is far too eager, and sometimes something wriggles beneath their skin.

barrow_king.name: The Barrow King
barrow_king.subtitle: Undying Monarch of the Damned
barrow_king.body: A king of the dead known only through the armies slumbering in his tombs and barrows. Tales say the dead rise when his resting places are disturbed, and that a tide of death will follow if he himself should ever wake.

beast_of_blight.name: The Beast of Blight
beast_of_blight.subtitle: The Rot in the Greenwood
beast_of_blight.body: A colossal creature of rot and fungus that moves through decay as easily as through air. The forest dies a little more wherever it passes, and the woodcutters who live nearby say it is grieving.

brimstone_behemoth.name: The Brimstone Behemoth
brimstone_behemoth.subtitle: Apocalyptic Colossus of Hellfire
brimstone_behemoth.body: A titan of hellfire and brimstone spoken of only in prophecies of the end of the world. Some realms are said to have bought time against it with terrible sacrifices.

chained_reaper.name: The Chained Reaper
chained_reaper.subtitle: Bearer of Chains
chained_reaper.body: A towering figure wrapped in heavy chains and wreathed in pale fire, glimpsed out past the cemetery fence. Those who hear its chains rattle at night lock their doors.

crimson_abbot.name: The Crimson Abbot
crimson_abbot.subtitle: Master of the Crimson Rose
crimson_abbot.body: The magnetic abbot of the Crimson Faith, whose sermons promise purity and everlasting life and whose congregation adores him without reservation. Those who have seen his true face in the sanctum speak of something monstrous beneath the vestments.

dusk_mother.name: The Dusk Mother
dusk_mother.subtitle: Shade of Motherly Anguish
dusk_mother.body: A wailing spectre carrying oversized shears and a great bell that tolls with her cries. She searches endlessly for her lost children — and for others to take their place.

galloping_headsman.name: The Galloping Headsman
galloping_headsman.subtitle: Headless Executioner of Vengeance
galloping_headsman.body: A headless horror of man and horse fused into one, flames pouring from where its head should be, carrying a great axe and a burning, skull-faced pumpkin. It rides for vengeance, and does not stop.

ghostlight_locomotive.name: The Ghostlight Locomotive
ghostlight_locomotive.subtitle: Corrupted Ghost Train
ghostlight_locomotive.body: The engine of the phantom train that carries the dead across the Shroud. When something corrupts its fire it wakes with a will of its own, its smokestack a gaping face, its eyes burning with every soul it has ever consumed.

grinning_sinner.name: The Grinning Sinner
grinning_sinner.subtitle: Dealer of Jinxes
grinning_sinner.body: A grinning crocodile-folk gambler who will play any game for any stake and always seems to know the odds. The bayou says he never loses — and that those who deal with him eventually lose everything.

harvest_terror.name: The Harvest Terror
harvest_terror.subtitle: Terror of the Fields
harvest_terror.body: A towering scarecrow of mouldering wicker with four tattered black wings and a great crow's head with amber eyes, carrying a chipped, bloodied scythe. It stalks the fields after dark, and the crows will not land where it walks.

horned_king.name: The Horned King
horned_king.subtitle: Crowned in Horns
horned_king.body: A shape glimpsed in the deepest woods: horns, three eyes the colour of old blood, and a voice that offers you everything you have ever wanted. The hollow's oldest warnings say never to sign anything he offers.

jinxed_leviathan.name: The Jinxed Leviathan
jinxed_leviathan.subtitle: Monster of the Black Water
jinxed_leviathan.body: An alligator grown to impossible size, lurking in the still, black water of hexed bayous. Bad luck seems to gather around it like flies.

lord_of_fools.name: The Lord of Fools
lord_of_fools.subtitle: Master of Revels
lord_of_fools.body: A grinning, jester-like lord who leads endless processions of revellers from town to town, compelling all who hear his music to dance, drink and make merry — until they drop.

tall_man.name: The Tall Man
tall_man.subtitle: The Thing Between the Trees
tall_man.body: An impossibly tall, thin figure glimpsed between the trunks of a rotting forest, who invites travellers to play hide and seek. Nobody who has played has ever told how the game ends.

vermintoll_abomination.name: The Vermintoll Abomination
vermintoll_abomination.subtitle: The Thing in the Cauldron
vermintoll_abomination.body: A heaving horror of feathers, fur and chitin bound to a great iron cauldron, shrieking in three voices at once. No one in the hollow will say where it came from.

weeping_widow.name: The Weeping Widow
weeping_widow.subtitle: The Grieving Matron
weeping_widow.body: A tall, veiled figure of grief whose cheeks are streaked with ink-black tears, surrounded by the cold tools of a surgeon. Her cures are said to work — though her patients are rarely the same afterwards.

white_worm.name: The White Worm
white_worm.subtitle: The Pale Thing Below
white_worm.body: A gargantuan, pallid grub from somewhere far beyond the stars, attended by countless smaller worms. Those who have stood near it speak of their thoughts slipping away like water.

wicker_man.name: The Wicker Man
wicker_man.subtitle: Blazing Sacrificial Colossus
wicker_man.body: A towering effigy of woven wicker, iron and wire, raised on a hilltop by its faithful, its hollow chest and limbs built like cages. It stands silent and still — until it is lit.

wild_titan.name: The Wild Titan
wild_titan.subtitle: Ferocious Giant of the Wilderness
wild_titan.body: A colossal giant of the most remote mountain ranges, the wilderness itself given shape. It wants nothing to do with towns and their people, and woe betide any that stand in its way.

corn_dolly.name: Corn Dolly
corn_dolly.subtitle: Grain Husk Companion
corn_dolly.body: Little figures of dried husk bound with twine, their faces ink-brushed with childlike smiles that curve a bit too wide. They seem to stand guard over those they choose — and their moods can turn in an instant.

crooked_hare.name: Crooked Hare
crooked_hare.subtitle: Crooked Trickster
crooked_hare.body: At first glance a rabbit — until you notice the small antlers, the wings, and the cunning gleam in its eye. Crooked hares steal things from travellers and hide them in amusing, unlikely places.

devils_glove.name: Devil’s Glove
devils_glove.subtitle: Five-Fingered Fungus
devils_glove.body: A blood-red fungus of five twitching, slime-slick tendrils, shaped like a long-fingered hand, growing from leathery white bulbs. It smells overpoweringly of death and rot — and some keep one anyway.

dingpot.name: Dingpot
dingpot.subtitle: Jovial Cauldron Helper
dingpot.body: A cheerful, bustling little cauldron that loves nothing more than serving up a good meal, a soothing tea or the occasional bubbling draught.

ghost_crawler.name: Ghost Crawler
ghost_crawler.subtitle: Spirit Spider
ghost_crawler.body: A small, ghostly spider, translucent as smoke apart from its long, jarringly solid legs, that skitters silently between the darkest corners and spins webs that fade from sight.

goatstealer.name: Goatstealer
goatstealer.subtitle: Hungry Livestock Snatcher
goatstealer.body: Hairless, reeking little predators with needle teeth that prey on livestock far larger than themselves. Their carrion-and-peat stench is the stuff of legend among herders.

hemonculus.name: Hemonculus
hemonculus.subtitle: Sanguine Servitor
hemonculus.body: A small, wet, crimson creature that seems to be made of blood, darting about on errands for whoever keeps it.

magpie_of_omens.name: Magpie of Omens
magpie_of_omens.subtitle: Bird of Fate and Fortune
magpie_of_omens.body: A black-and-white bird that brings tidings both fair and foul. To those who keep the Old Ways, its omens are always to be trusted.

moonshine.name: Moonshine
moonshine.subtitle: Lingering Soul Guide
moonshine.body: A gentle wandering spirit who has made peace with whatever once held it back, and chosen to stay a while anyway — often attaching itself to a living person it has taken a liking to.

nameless_thing.name: Nameless Thing
nameless_thing.subtitle: Unknowable Lifeform from Beyond
nameless_thing.body: Something that is not quite a small animal, an object or a piece of something larger — and is not from here. Looking at it for too long is unpleasant.

ravencraft.name: Ravencraft
ravencraft.subtitle: Undead Avian Amalgamation
ravencraft.body: A tiny, grotesque mockery of a bird, carelessly sewn together from feathers, sinew and bone. Its cries sound like they come from somewhere much further away.

salmon_of_knowledge.name: Salmon of Knowledge
salmon_of_knowledge.subtitle: Elemental Font of Wisdom
salmon_of_knowledge.body: A shimmering, iridescent fish swimming within a floating sphere of gently flowing water. Legends say it carries the wisdom of the ages.

witchwoven.name: Witchwoven
witchwoven.subtitle: Helper Made of Twine and Twigs
witchwoven.body: Little dolls of sticks, twine and scraps brought to life — sometimes by old nature magic, more often by those who know the Old Ways. Some are surprisingly romantic.
